items.text: ॐ सकलसौभाग्यदायकं श्रीविष्णुसहस्रनामस्तोत्रम्‌ ॥
items.tr: oṃ sakalasaubhāgyadāyakaṃ śrīviṣṇusahasranāmastotram ||
items.en: Om. Here begins the Vishnu Sahasranama, the hymn of a thousand names of Vishnu, which gives every kind of good fortune.

items.text:
शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम्।
प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये॥१॥
items.tr:
śuklāmbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam|
prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntaye||1||
items.en: To remove all obstacles, one should meditate on Vishnu, who wears white clothes, has the colour of the moon, has four arms and a calm, smiling face.

items.text:
यस्य द्विरदवक्त्राद्याः पारिषद्याः परः शतम्‌।
विघ्नं निघ्नन्ति सततं विष्वक्सेनं तमाश्रये॥२॥
items.tr:
yasya dviradavaktrādyāḥ pāriṣadyāḥ paraḥ śatam|
vighnaṃ nighnanti satataṃ viṣvaksenaṃ tamāśraye||2||
items.en: I take refuge in Vishvaksena, whose hundreds of attendants, led by the elephant-faced one, always destroy every obstacle.

items.text:
व्यासं वसिष्ठनप्तारं शक्तेः पौत्रमकल्मषम्‌।
पराशरात्मजं वन्दे शुकतातं तपोनिधिम्॥३॥
items.tr:
vyāsaṃ vasiṣṭhanaptāraṃ śakteḥ pautramakalmaṣam|
parāśarātmajaṃ vande śukatātaṃ taponidhim||3||
items.en: I bow to Vyasa, the great-grandson of Vasishtha, the grandson of Shakti, the son of Parashara and the father of Shuka; he is free of all fault and a treasure of austerity.

items.text:
व्यासाय विष्णुरूपाय व्यासरूपाय विष्णवे।
नमो वै ब्रह्मनिधये वासिष्ठाय नमो नमः॥४॥
items.tr:
vyāsāya viṣṇurūpāya vyāsarūpāya viṣṇave|
namo vai brahmanidhaye vāsiṣṭhāya namo namaḥ||4||
items.en: Salutation to Vyasa, who is a form of Vishnu, and to Vishnu, who is a form of Vyasa. Again and again I bow to him, the descendant of Vasishtha, the treasure-house of sacred knowledge.

items.text:
अविकाराय शुद्धाय नित्याय परमात्मने।
सदैकरूपरूपाय विष्णवे सर्वजिष्णवे॥५॥
items.tr:
avikārāya śuddhāya nityāya paramātmane|
sadaikarūparūpāya viṣṇave sarvajiṣṇave||5||
items.en: Salutation to Vishnu, who never changes, who is pure and eternal, the Supreme Self, always of one single nature, the one who conquers all.

items.text:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण जन्मसंसारबन्धनात्।
विमुच्यते नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे॥६॥
items.tr:
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa janmasaṃsārabandhanāt|
vimucyate namastasmai viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave||6||
items.en: Salutation to Vishnu, the mighty one, by simply remembering whom a person is set free from the bondage of birth and worldly life.

items.text: ॐ नमो विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे।
items.tr: oṃ namo viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave|
items.en: Om. Salutation to Vishnu, the mighty one.

items.speaker: श्रीवैशम्पायन उवाच
items.text:
श्रुत्वा धर्मानशेषेण पावनानि च सर्वशः।
युधिष्ठिरः शान्तनवं पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत॥७॥
items.tr:
śrutvā dharmānaśeṣeṇa pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ|
yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śāntanavaṃ punarevābhyabhāṣata||7||
items.en: Vaishampayana said: After hearing about all the duties and all the purifying teachings in full, Yudhishthira again spoke to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu.

items.speaker: युधिष्ठिर उवाच
items.text:
किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणम्।
स्तुवन्तः कं कमर्चन्तः प्राप्नुयुर्मानवाः शुभम्॥८॥
items.tr:
kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vāpyekaṃ parāyaṇam|
stuvantaḥ kaṃ kamarcantaḥ prāpnuyurmānavāḥ śubham||8||
items.en: Yudhishthira said: Who is the one God in the world? What is the one highest goal? By praising whom and by worshipping whom do people reach what is good?

items.text:
को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां भवतः परमो मतः।
किं जपन्मुच्यते जन्तुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात्॥९॥
items.tr:
ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ|
kiṃ japanmucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt||9||
items.en: Which duty do you think is the highest of all duties? By repeating what is a living being set free from the bondage of birth and worldly life?

items.speaker: भीष्म उवाच
items.text:
जगत्प्रभुं देवदेवमनन्तं पुरुषोत्तमम्।
स्तुवन् नामसहस्रेण पुरुषः सततोत्थितः॥१०॥
items.tr:
jagatprabhuṃ devadevamanantaṃ puruṣottamam|
stuvan nāmasahasreṇa puruṣaḥ satatotthitaḥ||10||
items.en: Bhishma said: A person who is always ready and praises with a thousand names the Lord of the world, the God of gods, the endless one, the Supreme Person,

items.text:
तमेव चार्चयन्नित्यं भक्त्या पुरुषमव्ययम्।
ध्यायन् स्तुवन् नमस्यंश्च यजमानस्तमेव च॥११॥
items.tr:
tameva cārcayannityaṃ bhaktyā puruṣamavyayam|
dhyāyan stuvan namasyaṃśca yajamānastameva ca||11||
items.en: and who, with devotion, always worships that same undying Person, meditating on him, praising him, bowing to him and offering sacrifice to him,

items.text:
अनादिनिधनं विष्णुं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्।
लोकाध्यक्षं स्तुवन्नित्यं सर्वदुःखातिगो भवेत्॥१२॥
items.tr:
anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram|
lokādhyakṣaṃ stuvannityaṃ sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet||12||
items.en: who daily praises Vishnu, who has no beginning and no end, the great Lord of all worlds and the overseer of the worlds, goes beyond all sorrow.

items.text:
ब्रह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं लोकानां कीर्तिवर्धनम्।
लोकनाथं महद्भूतं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम्॥१३॥
items.tr:
brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ lokānāṃ kīrtivardhanam|
lokanāthaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam||13||
items.en: He is devoted to the holy, knows all duties, increases the fame of the worlds, is the Lord of the worlds, the great Being, and the source from which all beings arise.

items.text:
एष मे सर्वधर्माणां धर्मोऽधिकतमो मतः।
यद्भक्त्या पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्तवैरर्चेन्नरः सदा॥१४॥
items.tr:
eṣa me sarvadharmāṇāṃ dharmo'dhikatamo mataḥ|
yadbhaktyā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ stavairarcennaraḥ sadā||14||
items.en: In my view, the highest of all duties is this: that a person should always worship the lotus-eyed Lord with devotion and with hymns of praise.

items.text:
परमं यो महत्तेजः परमं यो महत्तपः।
परमं यो महद्ब्रह्म परमं यः परायणम्॥१५॥
items.tr:
paramaṃ yo mahattejaḥ paramaṃ yo mahattapaḥ|
paramaṃ yo mahadbrahma paramaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam||15||
items.en: He is the highest great light, the highest great austerity, the highest great Brahman, and the highest refuge.

items.text:
पवित्राणां पवित्रं यो मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम्।
दैवतं दैवतानां च भूतानां योऽव्ययः पिता॥१६॥
items.tr:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam|
daivataṃ daivatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo'vyayaḥ pitā||16||
items.en: He is the purest of all pure things, the most auspicious of all auspicious things, the God of the gods, and the undying father of all beings.

items.text:
यतः सर्वाणि भूतानि भवन्त्यादियुगागमे।
यस्मिंश्च प्रलयं यान्ति पुनरेव युगक्षये॥१७॥
items.tr:
yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavantyādiyugāgame|
yasmiṃśca pralayaṃ yānti punareva yugakṣaye||17||
items.en: From him all beings come into being at the start of the first age, and into him they dissolve again when the age ends.

items.text:
तस्य लोकप्रधानस्य जगन्नाथस्य भूपते।
विष्णोर्नामसहस्रं मे शृणु पापभयापहम्॥१८॥
items.tr:
tasya lokapradhānasya jagannāthasya bhūpate|
viṣṇornāmasahasraṃ me śṛṇu pāpabhayāpaham||18||
items.en: O King, hear from me the thousand names of Vishnu, the chief of the worlds and Lord of the universe, which remove sin and fear.

items.text:
यानि नामानि गौणानि विख्यातानि महात्मनः।
ऋषिभिः परिगीतानि तानि वक्ष्यामि भूतये॥१९॥
items.tr:
yāni nāmāni gauṇāni vikhyātāni mahātmanaḥ|
ṛṣibhiḥ parigītāni tāni vakṣyāmi bhūtaye||19||
items.en: For the good of all, I will tell you the famous names of the great one which describe his qualities and which the sages have sung.

items.text:
ऋषिर्नाम्नां सहस्रस्य वेदव्यासो महामुनिः।
छन्दोऽनुष्टुप् तथा देवो भगवान् देवकीसुतः॥२०॥
items.tr:
ṛṣirnāmnāṃ sahasrasya vedavyāso mahāmuniḥ|
chando'nuṣṭup tathā devo bhagavān devakīsutaḥ||20||
items.en: The seer of these thousand names is the great sage Vedavyasa; the metre is Anushtup; and the deity is Lord Krishna, the son of Devaki.

items.text:
अमृतांशूद्भवो बीजं शक्तिर्देवकिनन्दनः।
त्रिसामा हृदयं तस्य शान्त्यर्थे विनियोज्यते॥२१॥
items.tr:
amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bījaṃ śaktirdevakinandanaḥ|
trisāmā hṛdayaṃ tasya śāntyarthe viniyojyate||21||
items.en: The seed is 'Amritamshudbhava', the power is 'the delight of Devaki', and the heart is 'Trisama'. It is used for bringing peace.

items.text:
विष्णुं जिष्णुं महाविष्णुं प्रभविष्णुं महेश्वरम्‌।
अनेकरूपदैत्यान्तं नमामि पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ prabhaviṣṇuṃ maheśvaram|
anekarūpadaityāntaṃ namāmi puruṣottamam || 22 ||
items.en: I bow to the Supreme Person: Vishnu, the victorious one, the great Vishnu, the mighty one, the great Lord, who destroyed demons of many forms.
